name: Repository Memory Auto Capture
description: Audit repository-memory evidence and capture reusable shared team memory without blocking ordinary agent work.

guardEnabled.description: Enable advisory repository-fact routing and final evidence audit.

enforcement.description: Compatibility label; this extension remains advisory and records observations without blocking ordinary tools.

repoToolPrefix.description: Host namespace used for repository-memory MCP tools.

agentIds.description: Only install/capture for these OpenClaw agent ids. The installer requires an explicit selection.

recallEnabled.description: Use the shared runtime for conversation-memory recall in before_prompt_build.

nativeTools.description: Register native OpenClaw read-only tools that delegate to the shared runtime.
